LibreOffice DrawingML preset shape definitions
Source repository: https://github.com/LibreOffice/core
Source commit: 9dea406ab7695df6325b11b0e19fdca8db4b7276
Original: oox/source/drawingml/customshapes/presetShapeDefinitions.xml
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see LICENSE.txt).
Original XML bytes are preserved. src/shapes.js compiles its default guides and paths.
The original XML, source notices, runtime template, and generator are included with this repository.
Rebuild: python scripts/build-shapes.py
Preset XY and polar adjustment handles are compiled from the original avLst/ahLst guides.
OOXML import/export and action-button behavior are not implied by this geometry dataset.
